# Event-Den (Event Denver)

> Event-Den is an event venue inside FieldhouseUSA Aurora, Colorado, serving the Denver metro. It offers about 70,000 sq ft of dedicated event space in a 93,000 sq ft building, including a 35,000 sq ft contiguous floor, for events of up to 1,200 guests. Every event is custom quoted.

- Address: 14200 E Alameda Ave, Suite 400, Aurora, CO 80012 (inside FieldhouseUSA Aurora, just off I-225 at Alameda)
- Email: admin@event-den.com
- Parking: free on-site lot
- Tours: by appointment
- Quotes: email with event date, guest count, event type, and hours; replies usually within one business day

## Space

- 35,000 sq ft main contiguous floor (galas, festivals, tournaments, weddings)
- 25,000 sq ft secondary open area (large receptions, expos)
- 10,000 sq ft finished event area and flex space (dinners, mitzvahs, corporate sessions)
- Convertible volleyball, basketball and pickleball courts under 40-foot ceilings
- The Social Den, an in-house lounge, workspace and meetings hall, adjoins for breakouts and VIP rooms

## Services

- On-site catering by Oda Bar & Cafe; outside caterers welcome for a fee
- Event-Den holds its own liquor license and runs turnkey bar programs
- Internal events coordinator available for any program at an additional fee
- In-house rentals (arches, rolling bars, staging and basic A/V, tables and linens), on-site or for pickup
- Brokered introductions to planners, vendors and partner venues (independent businesses, not guaranteed)
- Full wedding and event planning is referred to partner planners
